Mp ll 256, 11 ; 333, 16 ; Sadd 741, 22 ; — dhammo sanditthiko akāliko ~ o, D ll 93, 32 = M l 37, 21 = S V 343, 7 = A l 149, 16 ; sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ~ ā, S lV 339, 16 = A ll 198, 1 ; kittāvatā bho Gotama sanditthikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ~ aṃ, A l 158, 37 ; Nidd ll 267, 8 ; Sp 251, 17 ; — ° -tā , f., abstr. of prec.; ~ āya, Sv-pṭ l 14, 16 .
